verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud memory service with an open-source framework, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for Zep or Graphiti. Related privacy features, such as user deletion for Right To Be Forgotten requests, ABAC policies and audit/API logs, are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
